verdict.rationale: A state revenue agency could plausibly publish a developer API for things like rate lookup or filing, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no API reference, interactive or otherwise, and no runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and the documented channels are web portal workflows (My DOR, Express file) and a phone system.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
